cards.ex: CRISPR technology has been a real game changer in genetic research.
cards.exUz: CRISPR texnologiyasi genetik tadqiqotlarda haqiqiy tub o'zgarish bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaziyatni yoki sohani butunlay o'zgartiradigan yangilik yoki voqea.

cards.ex: New treatments for Alzheimer's are on the horizon, which is really encouraging.
cards.exUz: Alzheimer kasalligiga yangi davolash usullari ufqda, bu juda ruhlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Yaqin kelajakda paydo bo'lishi yoki sodir bo'lishi kutilayotgan.

cards.ex: I'm still trying to wrap my head around the implications of quantum physics.
cards.exUz: Men hali ham kvant fizikasi oqibatlarini tushunishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimani tushunishga yoki qabul qilishga harakat qilish, odatda murakkab narsa.

cards.ex: It's only a matter of time before we find a cure for cancer, I hope.
cards.exUz: Umid qilamanki, saraton kasalligiga davo topish faqat vaqt masalasi.
cards.uzDef: Muqarrar ravishda sodir bo'ladigan narsa, faqat vaqt kerak.

cards.ex: I want to dig into the research on sustainable energy sources.
cards.exUz: Men barqaror energiya manbalari bo'yicha tadqiqotlarni chuqur o'rganmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror mavzuni yoki masalani chuqur o'rganish.

cards.ex: Many promising scientific ideas fall by the wayside due to lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab umidli ilmiy g'oyalar moliyalashtirish yetishmasligi tufayli unutiladi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborsiz qoldirilganligi sababli muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash yoki unutilish.

cards.ex: You have to take those statistics with a grain of salt; they're not entirely reliable.
cards.exUz: Bu statistikani shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak; ular to'liq ishonchli emas.
cards.term: take with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga to'liq ishonmaslik, shubha bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Playing devil's advocate, what if climate change isn't as bad as we think?
cards.exUz: Qarshi fikr bildirib, iqlim o'zgarishi biz o'ylaganchalik yomon bo'lmasa nima bo'ladi?
cards.uzDef: Bahsda yoki muhokamada qarama-qarshi fikrni qo'llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs.

cards.ex: Finding life on other planets might seem like a long shot, but we have to keep searching.
cards.exUz: Boshqa sayyoralarda hayot topish kam imkoniyatdek tuyulishi mumkin, ammo biz qidirishni davom ettirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati kam bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The effects of social media are increasingly under the microscope.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning ta'siri tobora mikroskop ostida.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan o'rganilayotgan yoki tekshirilayotgan.

cards.ex: Colonizing Mars is still pie in the sky at this point.
cards.exUz: Marsni kolonizatsiya qilish hozircha hayoliy orzu.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan, hayoliy g'oya yoki reja.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi holatga qaytish, yangidan boshlash kerak bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The research is promising; we're definitely on the right track.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot umid beradi; biz aniq to'g'ri yo'ldamiz.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'nalishda ketayotgan, muvaffaqiyatga erishishga yaqin.

cards.ex: Technology is a double-edged sword; it can help us, but it can also harm us.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama qilich; u bizga yordam berishi mumkin, lekin zarar ham yetkazishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Once we connect the dots, the solution will become clear.
cards.exUz: Nuqtalarni bog'laganimizdan so'ng, yechim aniq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Aloqasi bo'lmagan ma'lumotlarni birlashtirib, ma'noni tushunish.

cards.ex: Down the line, this discovery could revolutionize medicine.
cards.exUz: Kelajakda bu kashfiyot tibbiyotni inqilob qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, keyinroq.

cards.ex: We've only scratched the surface of understanding the human brain.
cards.exUz: Biz inson miyasini tushunishning faqat yuzasini o'rgandik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning faqat yuzaki qismini o'rganish.

cards.ex: Technology is advancing in leaps and bounds.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tez va katta qadamlar bilan, juda tez rivojlanish.

cards.ex: The new vaccine will be put to the test in clinical trials.
cards.exUz: Yangi vaktsina klinik sinovlarda sinovdan o'tkaziladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning samaradorligini yoki ishonchliligini aniqlash uchun sinovdan o'tkazish.

cards.ex: Let's review the state of play with the Mars mission.
cards.exUz: Keling, Mars missiyasi bilan bog'liq vaziyatni ko'rib chiqaylik.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaziyat yoki holat.

cards.ex: You can't just pull those numbers out of thin air; you need evidence.
cards.exUz: Siz bu raqamlarni hech narsadan ololmaysiz; sizga dalil kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday manbasiz yoki asosiz paydo bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Genetically modifying humans could be a slippery slope.
cards.exUz: Odamlarni genetik modifikatsiya qilish xavfli yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir harakat yoki qaror salbiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan xavfli yo'l.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of control.
cards.exUz: Biz bu muammoni nazoratdan chiqishidan oldin yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani rivojlanishidan oldin to'xtatish yoki yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: Trying this new approach is a shot in the dark, but we have nothing to lose.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi yondashuvni sinab ko'rish tasodifiy urinish, lekin bizda yo'qotadigan hech narsa yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati kam bo'lgan, taxminiy urinish.

cards.ex: That lecture gave me a lot of fuel for thought about the future of AI.
cards.exUz: Bu ma'ruza menga AI kelajagi haqida o'ylash uchun ko'p material berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga, muhokama qilishga turtki beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: Don't take everything you read online at face value; check your sources.
cards.exUz: Onlaynda o'qigan hamma narsangizga so'ziga ishonmang; manbalaringizni tekshiring.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning haqiqatligiga hech qanday shubhasiz ishonish.

cards.ex: Science funding is a balancing act between basic research and applied science.
cards.exUz: Ilm-fanni moliyalashtirish asosiy tadqiqotlar va amaliy fan o'rtasidagi muvozanatdir.
cards.uzDef: Bir necha narsani bir vaqtda boshqarishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We need to get to the bottom of why the experiment failed.
cards.exUz: Tajriba nima uchun muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganini aniqlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammoning haqiqiy sababini aniqlash.

cards.ex: Understanding dark matter is a tough nut to crack.
cards.exUz: Qorong'u materiyani tushunish qiyin masala.
cards.uzDef: Yechish juda qiyin bo'lgan muammo.

cards.ex: His theory is on shaky ground because there's little evidence to support it.
cards.exUz: Uning nazariyasi noaniq asosda, chunki uni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan dalillar kam.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar yoki ishonchli ma'lumotlar yetarli bo'lmagan vaziyat.
